about_the_game:
Inkborn is a roguelike deckbuilder that takes you on a dynamic, strategic journey, unlike anything you’ve experienced before! Our original origami art style and evolving roster of opponents make every run unique.

⚔️ INKBORN  - UNFOLD THE FEATURES ⚔️

🎴 Engage in strategic, card-based combat as you face otherworldly creatures and epic challenges.

🎴 Experience a distinctive fusion of deckbuilding and RPG mechanics (skill tree included).

🎴 Use your cards in the right sequences to unleash more than 100 powerful combos.

🎴 Discover over 250 cards, and use them individually.

🎴 Customize your starter deck to suit your needs.

🎴 Gain Ideas, one-time items dropped by defeated foes and usable only in the battle they are earned, offering game-changing effects to turn the tide of the fight.

🎴 Find memorable quotes that shape the world and its eerie atmosphere in fights.

🎴 Around 40 random unique events.

🎴 Traverse the mysterious realms and explore a non-linear world created from paper and ink.

🎴 Build and expand your shelter - The Town.

🎴 Unlock a vast array of cards and abilities to shape your journey.

🎴 Enjoy high replayability, thanks to meticulously designed procedural generation.

🎴 Every step you take comes with rewards and consequences, so choose your path wisely.

🎴 Pay heed to the Chronicles, or risk suffering the consequences of rewriting history!

🎴 Immerse yourself in a game co-developed by award-winning board game designer Jamey Stegmaier, the mastermind behind Scythe, Charterstone, and Viticulture.

⚔️ ABOUT INKBORN ⚔️

📜 Explore a twisted origami world, where mysterious creatures lurk, brought to life by an unknown force.

📜 Fight your way through the darkened landscape with the aid of legendary writers from the past and your relentless determination, unraveling a tragic mystery.

📜 Wield your deck of cards as an arsenal of abilities, but remember that its true power remains untapped.

📜 Rest in the Town - a safe haven where you can expand its structures, helping you on your journey ahead.

short_description: A roguelike, deckbuilder game with a twist, tactical combat, and huge replayability. Collect cards, traverse the dark lands, battle elusive enemies, and grow your town - as you push deeper into the chasm of madness.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
